LanguageData.FB_FleshBulwark.label: flesh bulwark
LanguageData.FB_FleshBulwark.description: A knot of reinforced tissue that strengthens its own and nearby territories against burn parties. Does not increase hemogel extraction.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTreeNursery.label: flesh grove
LanguageData.FB_FleshTreeNursery.description: Dense growths of flesh trees and flesh leaves that accelerate hemogel extraction from local biomass. Increased extraction depletes the territory faster.
LanguageData.FB_FleshRiverSiphon.label: river siphon
LanguageData.FB_FleshRiverSiphon.description: A large feeding organ that increases hemogel extraction by rivers, lakes, and coasts. Requires access to water and depletes the territory faster.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCamp.label: flesh ambush camp
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCamp.description: A patch of flesh adapted to ambush animals and passing caravans. Increases hemogel extraction and gathers trophies for delivery to an outpost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshCrustCorer.label: deep borer
LanguageData.FB_FleshCrustCorer.description: A drilling organ that extracts minerals at the expense of local biomass. Rapidly depletes the territory; hills and mountains yield rare resources more often.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelNexus.label: tunnel node
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelNexus.description: Grows a distant tunnel maw for instant travel by caravans and war packs. Can grow a new passage after the old one is collapsed.
